**Resident Evil 2 / Resident Evil 3 Fusion Fix (Dolphin)** adds door skipping, faster door transitions through emulator unthrottling, and Logitech RGB lighting for the GameCube versions of the games.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#re2re3gc) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/ResidentEvil2.RE3.Dolphin.FusionFix/dllmain.cpp)

</div>

---

## Options

- **Door animations** — Skip door animations.
- **Loading** — Unthrottle the emulator during door skipping to speed up loading.
- **RGB lighting** — Support [Logitech G LIGHTSYNC RGB Lighting](https://www.logitechg.com/innovation/lightsync-rgb.html).

Plugin should be compatible with any recent version of the emulator, but if not, open an issue.

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive beside the Dolphin x64 executable, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Launch the game in Dolphin once to create `scripts/ResidentEvil2.RE3.Dolphin.FusionFix.cfg`.
4. Configure the fix on fusionfix.io or in FusionFixHub. Restart when an option requires it.

## Hub settings

Door skipping, faster door transitions and RGB health lighting are enabled by default. Configure the fix on fusionfix.io or in FusionFixHub, then restart Dolphin. There is no in-game settings menu. The games retain their original 4:3 pre-rendered backgrounds; there is no adjustable free-camera field of view or added HUD-width setting. An old `scripts/ResidentEvil2.RE3.Dolphin.FusionFix.ini` isn't used anymore and can be deleted. Choose graphics and anti-aliasing settings in Dolphin.

## Presets and FusionFixHub

- Presets: Vanilla turns off the door skip and unthrottled door loading; Recommended (the defaults) and Enhanced turn them on. Vanilla also turns off RGB lighting.
- Setting texts: English, French, German, Italian and Spanish.
- FusionFixHub can change the settings while Dolphin runs; they apply the next time Dolphin starts.

## Known limits

- HUD aspect controls, startup skipping, movie framing and replacement controller icons are not supported.
- Switching discs or resetting Dolphin during door loading has not been checked.
